protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. In usernamespaced CRI containers, a21b178f12b223d48245fac4ad12a0c7b50bf20f added updateContainerIOOwner and passed WithUIDOwner/WithGIDOwner to NewTask. The pre-fix task option helpers created a fresh runc options.Options when TaskInfo.Options was nil, and NewTask serialized that object as the CreateTaskRequest options, so container runtime options such as SystemdCgroup were not carried forward. The resulting driver/path mismatch placed workload containers outside the Kubernetes pod cgroup hierarchy and could bypass limits. The official CVE record is PUBLISHED and the GHSA is not withdrawn.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed a21b178f12b223d48245fac4ad12a0c7b50bf20f. It is the smallest public commit that introduced the userns-only CRI task-option injection which activates the pre-existing replacement behavior; the release/2.0 commit cf07f28ee22a6df79177b55751902b24548105ad is a patch-identical backport, not the original BIC.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed against immediate parent 207ad711eabd375a01713109a8a197d197ff6542.
